title.narrative: 97.8% of PHCs now have safe water systems, and 15 schools benefit from climate-resilient water supply. National WASH standards for health facilities have been endorsed. Through the Red Dot campaign, children and adolescents in 562 schools and 32 nunneries have been sensitized on menstrual hygiene, strengthening health and hygiene outcomes.
